description: Repairs r-txn-1b/xproc-reader-own-level: B's five reads were within about 40 ms of A's update and Row 1 never showed 100, so staleness was not separated from non-visibility. On r-txn-1b-main-accdb, both processes open the main file shared read/write in Workspaces(0). b: BeginTrans; reads Wide rows 1, 2 and 64 through a new snapshot. a: UPDATE Wide SET V = 100 WHERE ID = 1 with no level (dbFailOnError). b: waits 7 s; reads rows 1, 2 and 64 as is, after DBEngine.Idle(dbRefreshCache) and again; CommitTrans; DBEngine.Errors; waits 7 s; reads them as is and after Idle.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
